senses.gloss: to go forth; to rise (of the sun); to go out.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:7">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>אֵצֵא ויהיו וכ׳</he> I shall leave (my father’s house), and they may desecrate &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:11">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ לו מוניטון</he> a medal was issued in his memory, v. <cite ref="M00538"><he>מוֹנִיטוֹן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>בשעה שהוא יוצא</he> when he (the sun) rises; <he>בשעה שהיא יוֹצֵאת</he> when she (the moon) rises.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:2">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ארור שיָצָאת זו מחלציו</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) cursed is he from whose loins this woman went forth.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:1">Sabb. V, 1</cite> <he>במה … יוֹצְאָה</he> what is an animal permitted to wear on going out (on the Sabbath)? Ib. VI, 1 <he>לא תֵצֵא וכ׳</he> a woman must not wear on going out &c.; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to end; to go to the end of, to live through.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:5:8">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כיון שיָצָת שבת</he> when the Sabbath ended.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:7">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>אינו יוצא שבתו ולא יָ׳ וכ׳</he> he shall not live to the end of this week, and he did not arrive at the end of the week before he was dead; (<cite ref="Eruvin 63a:16">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>הוציא שנתו</he>, v. infra); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be expended.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:21">Num. R. s. 14</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="E00266"><he>הוֹצָאָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be excluded; exempt; (rarely) to exclude, deduct.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 2:2:4">Y. Ned. II, beg. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ דבר של איסור</he> this is to exclude a vow concerning a forbidden act; Bab.
<cite ref="Nedarim 17a:1">Ned. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ נשבע לבטל וכ׳</he> this excludes the case of one who makes oath that he will disregard a law.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:1:15">Y. Yeb. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top <he>אשר תלד יָצְתָה זו וכ׳</he> ‘whom she may bear’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:6">Deut. XXV, 6</cite>), herewith is excluded she (the <cite ref="A01283"><he>אַיְילוֹנִית</he></cite>) who &c.; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:6:2">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ</cite> top <he>צֵא מהם שני ימים</he> deduct from them two days; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:6:2">ib.</cite> <he>צא שבת מהם</he> deduct the Sabbath day.—Esp. idiomatic uses:

senses.gloss: י׳ בן חורין, י׳ לחירות, or only י׳ to be freed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:8">Peah III, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 42a:14">Gitt. 42ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24a">Kidd. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>יוצאבשן וכ׳</he> he is freed, when his master caused his loss of a tooth or an eye; a. v. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (of a wife) to be sent away, to be divorced.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:6">Keth. VII, 6</cite> <he>ואלו יוֹצְאוֹת שלא בכתובה</he> the following wives have to leave without receiving their K’thubah.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>תֵּצֵא</he> she must leave.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 10:5">Ib. X, 5</cite>; a. v. fr.—
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: י׳ ידי (or מִידֵי) to go out of the power of; to be released; to do justice to, be justified before.
units: Shek. III, 2 … לפי שאדם צריך לָצֵאת ידי הבריות לָצֵאת ידי המקום because man must appear justified before men as well as before God; Ex. R. s. 51; a. fr.—י׳ ידי חובתו, or י׳ to comply with the requirements of the law.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite> <he>אם כיון לבו י׳</he> if he read with attention, he has done his duty (which requires the reading of the Sh’ma).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:5">Y. Shek. III, 47ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מהו לצאת וכ׳</he> is the law complied with when one uses wine &c.?—Mekh. Bo, Pisḥa, s. 6; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:11">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>לא יָצָאתָה ידי השבועה</he> thou hast not redeemed thy oath; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:11">ib.</cite> s. 49; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10:5">Lev. R. s. 10</cite>, beg.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:5">Makhsh. VI, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:3">Tosef. Toh. X, 3</cite> <he>י׳ מידי שמן</he>, v. <cite ref="M00456"><he>מוֹחַל</he></cite>.—<he>י׳ מידי פשוטו</he>, v. <cite ref="M02452"><he>מִקְרָא</he></cite>.—
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: י׳ מן הכלל or י׳ to be taken out of the general rule, to be specified (although being implied in the general rule). Sifra, introd. כל דבר שהיה בכלל וי׳ … לא ללמד על עצמו י׳ וכ׳ whatever would have been implied in the general law and yet is specified again (in the Biblical text) in order to teach (something not mentioned before), has been specified not only to teach something new concerning the specific case, but to teach it concerning the whole class.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:3">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ לטעון</he>, v. <cite ref="I00614"><he>טָעַן</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 1:6">Tem. I, 6</cite> <he>ולמה י׳</he> and for what purpose are tithes especially mentioned (<cite ref="Leviticus 27:30">Lev. XXVII, 30</cite>, sq.)?; a. fr.—
senses.label: d

senses.gloss: כַּיּוֹצֵא ב־ like that which passes with it (in the same class), similar; in a similar way.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:2">Pes. III, 2</cite> <he>אם יש כי׳ בו שהחמיץ</he> if there is a similar dough (started simultaneously with the one in question) which has begun to ferment.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59b">Ber. 59ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>ואין לו כי׳ בו</he> when he has no house like it; <he>כי׳ בהם</he> garments like them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:6">Zeb. V, 6</cite> <he>המורם מהם כי׳ בהם</he> what is taken of them for the priest, is like them (subject to the same laws).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:19">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כי׳ בדבר אתה אומר וכ׳</he> in a similar way (as something coming under the same category) you read &c.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 32">Sifré Num. 32</cite>; a. v. fr.—
senses.label: e

senses.gloss: י׳ שכרו בהפסדו its benefit is lost in its disadvantage; i.e. benefit and disadvantage are counterbalanced.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:11">Ab. V, 11</cite>, sq.—
senses.label: f

senses.gloss: (euphem.) to retire for human needs (v.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:2">Toh. X, 2</cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:21">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>השכם וצֵא וכ׳</he> go out early in the morning &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:8">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>ואינו יוצא לנקביו</he> and has no human needs.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:8">Ib.</cite> <he>לא היה יוצא אלא וכ׳</he> he used to go out only to the water (to make believe he was a superhuman being); a. fr.—
senses.label: g

senses.gloss: to be proved, identified.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 2:3">Keth. II, 3</cite> <he>היה כתב ידם יוצא ממקום אחר</he> if their signature can be identified otherwise (than by their own declaration); a. e.
senses.label: h

senses.gloss: to take out, to lead forth, bring forth; to release, discharge, send off.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:1">Ber. VI, 1</cite> before eating bread one says, <he>המוֹצִיא לחם וכ׳</he> (blessed be thou, O Lord) who hast brought forth bread out of the earth (v.
<cite ref="Berakhot 38a">ib. 38ᵃ</cite> as to <he>המוציא</he> or <he>מוציא</he>); ib. 37ᵇ; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41b">Ab. Zar. 41ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין ספק מוציא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="F00014"><he>וַדַּאי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 37b:3">B. Mets. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>לא זו הדרך מוֹצִיאָתוֹ מידי עבירה עד וכ׳</he> this is not the way that relieves him from sin (this is no full atonement), (he is not relieved) until he pays &c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 15:7">Yeb. XV, 7</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 15:6">Ib. 6</cite>, sq. <he>אין זו דרך מוֹצִיאָתָהּ וכ׳</he> she is not relieved from the possibility of sin, unless she is not permitted to marry again and forbidden to partake of T’rumah.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 36b">Ib. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>יוֹצִיא</he> (<he>יוֹצִיאָהּ</he>) <he>בגט</he> he dismisses her with a letter of divorce.
<cite ref="Yevamot 36b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם נשא יוציא</he> and if he married her (against the law), he must dismiss her (divorce her); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:11">Ab. II, 11</cite>, a. fr. <he>מוֹצִיאִין את האדם מן העולם</he> take a man out of the world, i.e. cause him to lose the true enjoyment of life.

senses.gloss: to exclude. Y. Yeb. I, 2ᶜ top איילונית מטעם אחר הוֹצֵאתָהּ the aylonith thou dost (the law does) exclude for another reason (v. supra).
units: Num. R. s. 14, end אוֹצִיא את ישראל let me exclude the Israelites, א׳ את הזקנים the elders; a. fr.—להוֹצִיא (= ch. לאפוקי, v. אַפֵּק, or למעוטי, v. מעט) to the exclusion of.
Succ. 28ᵃ; Kidd. 34ᵃ האזרח לה׳ את הנשים ‘the native’ (Lev. XXIII, 42) intimates the exemption of women (from the duty of dwelling in booths); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to lead to the end, to live through.
units: Erub. 63ᵃ, v. supra.—4) to produce, present.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:8">Keth. XIII, 8</cite> <he>המוציא שטר חוב … והלה ה׳ וכ׳</he> if one produces a note of indebtedness against his neighbor, and the latter produces evidence that the claimant sold him a field (and paid him, which he would not have done, if he had a claim).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:9">Ib. 9</cite>.
Ib. IX, 9 הוֹצִיאָה גט if she produces a letter of divorce; a. v. fr.—5) to spend, lay out. Ib. VIII, 5, v. הוֹצָאָה; a. fr.—Esp. idiomatic uses:

senses.gloss: ה׳ ידי חוב־ or ה׳ (v. supra) to be the instrument of a person’s complying with the law, e.g. to read a prayer and thus cause the listener to perform his duty as though he read it himself; to act in another’s behalf effectively.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:5">R. Hash. III, 5</cite> <he>אין מוֹצִיאִין את הרבים ידי חובתן</he> they cannot act (blow the Shofar) in behalf of the assembled congregation.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 29a:17">Ib. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״פ שיצא מוציא</he> although he has done his duty (has read the prayer for himself), he may act in behalf of others.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 29a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>ולעצמו מוציא</he> and can he (the half-slave and half-freedman) act in his own behalf?; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to collect, to claim.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 8:1">Keth. VIII, 1</cite> <he>הבעל מוציא מיד הלקוחות</he> the husband can reclaim the property from those who bought it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:11">B. Kam. III, 11</cite> <he>המוציא מחבירו עליו הראייה</he> the claimant must produce evidence; a. v. fr.—
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to utter.
units: Arakh. 5ᵃ, a. fr. אין אדם מוציא דבריו לבטלה no man utters his words for no purpose (he must have meant something).—ה׳ לעז to slander, discredit.
<cite ref="Shabbat 97a">Sabb. 97ᵃ</cite>, a. fr., v. <cite ref="L00604"><he>לַעַז</he></cite>.—
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: to carry an object (on the Sabbath) out of a private to a public place, or from one private place to another, v. רָשׁוּת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—
senses.label: d

senses.gloss: to secrete.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 88:1">Sifré Num. 88</cite> <he>יש לך … שאין מוציא וכ׳</he> is there a woman-born being that does not discharge the food he eats?; a. e.—
senses.label: e

senses.gloss: ה׳ שבת to dismiss the Sabbath with prayer, opp. הכניס.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 118b:4">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>מוֹצִיאֵי שבת וכ׳</he> those who dismiss the Sabbath at Sepphoris.
senses.label: f
